sample_retrievals.query: I bought a defective product and the seller refuses to replace or refund it.

candidates.text: Where any goods sold to a consumer suffer from a manufacturing defect or fail to perform as specified in the product description, the seller or manufacturer shall be liable to replace the defective item without extra charge or issue a full monetary refund within fourteen calendar days of complaint submission.
candidates.issue: Defective product replacement and full refund rights
candidates.section_title: Right to Replacement or Refund for Defective Goods
candidates.plain_explanation: If you buy a product that is defective or doesn't work as advertised, the seller must replace it for free or give you a full refund within 14 days.
candidates.applicability: Applies to all retail and e-commerce purchases of physical goods.

candidates.text: Manufacturers shall not void a consumer product warranty solely because the consumer engaged an independent technician for routine maintenance, provided the maintenance did not directly cause the alleged defect.
candidates.issue: Warranty void claims based on unauthorized third-party repairs
candidates.section_title: Right to Repair and Warranty Protections
candidates.plain_explanation: Companies cannot cancel your warranty just because an independent repair shop did basic maintenance on your device.
candidates.applicability: Applies to electronic items, appliances, and motor vehicles.

candidates.text: Any service provider or retailer publishing advertisements containing false representations regarding price, origin, quality, or features of products commits an unfair trade practice. Affected consumers are entitled to compensation and statutory damages up to twice the purchase price.
candidates.issue: Misleading advertising and deceptive price claims
candidates.section_title: Prohibition of Unfair Trade Practices and Misleading Ads
candidates.plain_explanation: Sellers cannot use false advertisements or fake discounts. If they trick you with false claims, you can demand compensation.
candidates.applicability: Applies to advertisements, promotional offers, and marketing across print, digital, and broadcast media.

candidates.text: E-commerce platforms that fail to deliver ordered goods within the confirmed delivery timeline without valid force majeure reasons shall automatically refund the full transaction amount along with a default compensation penalty of 5 percent per week of delay.
candidates.issue: Deficiency of service in e-commerce logistics and non-delivery
candidates.section_title: Duties of Digital Platforms regarding Delivery Timelines
candidates.plain_explanation: Online stores must deliver your order on time. If they fail without a valid reason, you get a full refund plus a delay penalty.
candidates.applicability: Applies to online shopping platforms and third-party sellers.

candidates.text: Any vendor selling packaged food items beyond their specified expiry date or containing unapproved chemical contaminants shall refund the consumer and reimburse medical expenses incurred as a direct consequence.
candidates.issue: Adulterated or substandard food items purchased at retail
candidates.act: Dummy Food Safety and Standards Regulation, 2024
candidates.section_title: Liability for Sale of Contaminated or Expired Foodstuffs
candidates.plain_explanation: If a shop sells expired or contaminated food that makes you sick, they must refund you and pay your medical expenses.
candidates.applicability: Applies to supermarkets, restaurants, and food delivery services.

sample_retrievals.query: My employer has not paid my monthly salary for two months.

candidates.text: Employers must disburse accrued wages to employees no later than the 7th working day of the following calendar month. Unreasonable delay beyond 15 days incurs a statutory penalty interest rate of 12 percent per annum payable directly to the employee.
candidates.issue: Unpaid salary and illegal withholding of earned wages
candidates.act: Dummy Fair Employment and Wages Act, 2024
candidates.section_title: Timely Disbursement of Monthly Wages
candidates.plain_explanation: Your boss must pay your monthly salary by the 7th of every month. If delayed past 15 days, they owe you extra interest.
candidates.applicability: Applies to all salaried, contract, and casual workers in commercial establishments.

candidates.text: No employer shall terminate a permanent worker without serving 30 days written notice or providing salary in lieu of notice, alongside severance pay calculated as 15 days salary per completed year of service.
candidates.issue: Abrupt termination of employment without contractual notice or severance
candidates.act: Dummy Fair Employment and Wages Act, 2024
candidates.section_title: Mandatory Notice Period and Severance Compensation
candidates.plain_explanation: Bosses cannot fire regular employees without 30 days notice or 30 days pay, plus 15 days of salary for every year worked.
candidates.applicability: Applies to permanent employees with at least one year of continuous service.

candidates.text: Every woman employed for at least 80 days in the preceding twelve months is entitled to 26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave. It is illegal to terminate an employee during or on account of maternity leave.
candidates.issue: Denial of paid maternity leave and benefit entitlement
candidates.section_title: Entitlement to Paid Maternity Leave and Job Protection
candidates.plain_explanation: Female workers who completed 80 days of work are entitled to 26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave. Employers cannot fire a pregnant employee.
candidates.applicability: Applies to all private and public establishments employing 10 or more persons.

candidates.text: Working hours exceeding 8 hours per day or 48 hours per week constitute overtime work. Overtime hours must be compensated at not less than twice the worker's ordinary hourly rate.
candidates.issue: Overtime work performed without double-rate compensation
candidates.act: Dummy Fair Employment and Wages Act, 2024
candidates.section_title: Maximum Working Hours and Overtime Pay
candidates.plain_explanation: If you work more than 8 hours a day or 48 hours a week, your employer must pay you double your hourly rate for extra hours.
candidates.applicability: Applies to industrial workers, retail employees, and office staff.

candidates.text: Landlords cannot increase rent during an active lease agreement unless agreed upon in writing. Annual rent escalation shall not exceed 7 percent and requires three months prior written notice.
candidates.issue: Unilateral and arbitrary increase in monthly rent during lease period
candidates.section_title: Rent Revision Rules and Notice Requirements
candidates.plain_explanation: Landlords cannot raise rent in the middle of a fixed lease. Yearly rent increases cannot exceed 7% and need 3 months written notice.
candidates.applicability: Applies to all registered residential lease agreements.

sample_retrievals.query: The landlord refuses to return my rental security deposit after moving out.

candidates.text: The security deposit for residential premises shall not exceed two months rent. Landlords must refund the full security deposit, minus itemized actual damages, within thirty days of tenant vacation of premises.
candidates.issue: Unlawful retention of rental security deposit by landlord
candidates.section_title: Limits on Security Deposit and Refund Deadlines
candidates.plain_explanation: Your security deposit cannot be more than 2 months rent. The landlord must return it within 30 days of moving out, deducting only proven repair costs.
candidates.applicability: Applies to residential tenancy agreements.

candidates.text: No landlord shall evict a tenant or enter rented premises forcibly without serving a valid 30-day notice specifying statutory grounds and securing an eviction order from the competent Rent Authority.
candidates.issue: Forced eviction without proper notice or court order
candidates.section_title: Protection Against Arbitrary Eviction
candidates.plain_explanation: A landlord cannot lock you out or force you to leave without giving a 30-day written notice and obtaining an official court order.
candidates.applicability: Applies to all residential and commercial tenants.

candidates.text: Landlords are responsible for structural repairs, roof leaks, and electrical safety. If the landlord fails to carry out essential repairs within 15 days of notice, the tenant may perform repairs and deduct cost from monthly rent.
candidates.issue: Landlord refusing essential structural repairs and maintenance
candidates.section_title: Maintenance Responsibilities and Emergency Repairs
candidates.plain_explanation: Landlords must fix major structural or roof issues. If they ignore your 15-day notice, you can fix it yourself and deduct the cost from your rent.
candidates.applicability: Applies to residential rented properties.

candidates.text: Landlords must provide at least 24 hours prior written notice before entering leased premises for inspections or repairs. Entry must take place during reasonable daytime hours (8:00 AM to 6:00 PM).
candidates.issue: Unannounced landlord intrusions violating tenant privacy
candidates.section_title: Tenant Right to Privacy and Landlord Entry Protocol
candidates.plain_explanation: Landlords must give you at least 24 hours written notice before coming over for inspection, and visits must happen during daytime hours.
candidates.applicability: Applies to residential leased premises.

candidates.text: No landlord or property agent shall disconnect essential services including water, electricity, sanitary connections, or elevator access to force tenant compliance or eviction. Breach incurs immediate Restoration Orders and fines.
candidates.issue: Cut-off of water or electricity supply by landlord to force tenant exit
candidates.section_title: Prohibition of Withholding Essential Utility Services
candidates.plain_explanation: Landlords are legally forbidden from cutting off your water, electricity, or gas to force you to leave or pay disputed fees.
candidates.applicability: Applies to all rental properties.

qualified_chunks.issue: Unlawful retention of rental security deposit by landlord
qualified_chunks.section_title: Limits on Security Deposit and Refund Deadlines
qualified_chunks.plain_explanation: Your security deposit cannot be more than 2 months rent. The landlord must return it within 30 days of moving out, deducting only proven repair costs.
